summary: First testing pass for Anam Cara. Backend pytest suite (19 tests) — 18/19 passed initially due to a test-only assertion mistake (modes use 'name' not 'label'), fixed; all 19 pass after correction. All required endpoints work: 9 modes, 20-question quiz per mode with final 'open' type, quiz submit returns headline/body/echo/coping/story/disclaimer (curated fallback when wall is empty; switches to approved-wall story when available), wall create/list (only approved), banned-pattern flagging via http URL, bcrypt+JWT admin login, /auth/me, admin moderation CRUD, and /admin/stats. Frontend: home renders hero + principles + footer disclaimer, /modes shows 9 cards, mode -> quiz works with 4 scale options each, /wall/submit shows thank-you, /admin/login rejects wrong creds and redirects to /admin on correct creds (admin@anamcara.app / anamcara2026), dashboard shows tabs + counts (pending/approved/rejected/flagged/quizzes done) and approve/reject/delete UI is present.

minor.issue: Too-short body returns 422 (Pydantic min_length) rather than 400 — spec said 'rejects too-short body'; 422 is acceptable but inconsistent with the explicit 400 raised for empty/unknown-mode cases.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — should migrate to lifespan handlers.
No brute-force/rate-limit lockout after 5 failed attempts (playbook expectation).
allow_origins defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins; set explicit CORS_ORIGINS for prod.

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright could not locate the final-question textarea via plain 'textarea' selector — likely a custom component or different data-testid; final submit button also not found by text 'Submit'. API confirms last question is type=open, so this is a selector/labeling issue, not functional break. Add data-testid='quiz-open-textarea' and data-testid='quiz-submit-button' for testability.
data-testid='wall-refresh-button' not found by selector during automation. Either rename or expose testid consistently.
data-testid='stats-*' not present on stat tiles (visually they render fine: 5 pending / 0 approved / 0 rejected / 1 flagged / 4 quizzes done). Add per-stat testids for stable assertions.

action_items: Optional: standardise wall too-short response to 400 (currently 422 from Pydantic).
Add explicit data-testid='quiz-open-textarea', 'quiz-submit-button', 'wall-refresh-button', and 'stats-pending/approved/rejected/flagged/quizzes' for stable e2e selectors.
Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown handlers to the lifespan API (deprecation warning).
Tighten CORS: replace '*' default with explicit allowed origins since allow_credentials=True.
Consider login brute-force protection (lockout after 5 failures) per the auth playbook.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses on_event('startup') which is deprecated; switch to lifespan.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid combination per CORS spec.
Banned regex is reasonable but very narrow; flagged-only approach is fine since admin moderates.
JWT also returned in body AND set as httpOnly cookie — fine, but documented duplication.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows render & function; some testids missing)

test_credentials: admin@anamcara.app / anamcara2026 — verified working via /api/auth/login and via /admin/login UI.
seed_data_creation: During testing the suite created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed wall reflections (created/approved/rejected/deleted). Some TEST_ reflections from frontend automation remain in 'pending' state and are visible in the admin dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_anamcara.py and reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_anamcara.py -v. Admin seeding happens on backend startup; if password changes, the existing record is updated. The reflection-wall fallback-to-curated story logic is verified working (curated when no approved entries for that mode; approved-wall story when present).
rca of the issue: Initial test_modes_nine failure was a test-only bug: asserted 'label' field but content.py MODES use 'name'. Fixed in the test file. No application defect.
